first.rationale: Prioritize verification of onboarding simplification and promotional pricing because both are highly consequential under the current activation/completion decline and competitive price pressure. Current intent is a standard onboarding-simplification experiment: it directly addresses the declining completion metric and has durable evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption, which is more likely to support sustainable qualified revenue than a broad price response. Pricing remains a credible alternative but carries greater long-term margin and customer-quality risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard onboarding-simplification experiment this week. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified short-term qualified-revenue lift was accompanied by 12% lower 30-day retention and failure to survive the first renewal cycle. Monitor qualified activation and retention, not completion alone, to ensure the gain translates into durable value.
